title: Senior Content Designer
description: About Us: Moniepoint Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial ecosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed. At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts, bank integration, payment gateway, etc. We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but also have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses. About this role: As a Senior Content Designer, you take ownership of the quality and strategic direction of content across your squad or product area. You bring expert content design judgment, deep user insight, and a collaborative mindset to shape product experiences that are clear, inclusive, and emotionally engaging. You support junior content designers, influence cross-team content strategy, and play a vital role in driving alignment across product, design, and engineering. You display an exceptional grasp of design thinking and content design expertise and are comfortable delivering well-thought out ideas to senior stakeholders and driving content design strategy each day.  What you’ll do  You are responsible for end-to-end content design strategy and execution on a project, from discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration. Partnering closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to embed content strategy in product discovery and delivery, shaping scope, trade-offs, and sequencing. Define for exceptional, accessible, and inclusive content that builds trust, clarity, and meaningful user engagement. Comfortable wireframing and prototyping and delivering your work in Figma, with clear rationale, adhering to a design systems and content design principles. Define content design strategy that aligns with business objectives and technical feasibility, ensuring content is not just clear but emotionally intelligent and on brand. Craft high-quality content for complex product flows, interface text, microcopy, error messaging, help content, and documentation, setting the bar for tone, clarity, and consistency. Take a strong role in qualitative and quantitative research methods (user interviews, usability tests, A/B experiments, content audits, analytics) using insight as a core design input. Collaborate deeply, proactively shaping product direction, surfacing trade-offs, and influencing delivery approaches. Drive the evolution of content design style guides, working closely with brand, marketing, and communications teams. Design thoughtful content that enhances usability, emotional impact, and user satisfaction. Balance speed and rigour with strong judgment on when to ship versus polish, especially on complex or fast-moving environments. Support junior content designers on the team and supports in terms of stakeholder management.  Lead alignment and collaboration across teams and stakeholders, clearly communicating content design rationale and facilitating strategic working sessions. Set a high standard for product teams, fostering a culture of sound content design practices, constructive feedback, and shared accountability. You are able to justify content design decisions to senior stakeholders with clear rationale and delivers work in a standardised format that you help to evolve. You are able to deliver multiple variations, informed by insights and can confidently explain the pros and cons of particular solutions. What you need to succeed 5+ years of experience working as a content designer.  You are incredibly comfortable with the design aspect of content design – understanding this role is deeper than 'just words'. Strong stakeholder management skills are a must for this role.  You must be able to work in a fast-changing environment where processes are still being defined.  Exceptional knowledge of content design principles and end-to-end product thinking.  Experience with A/B testing, UX metrics, and data interpretation and the ability to drive your own research initiatives.  Exceptional product intuition - understanding user needs, business constraints, and technical feasibility. Good knowledge of Figma - how to collaborate, create prototypes, and work to produce agile solutions quickly, with little to no help.  Experience using AI a plus. Great if you’ve built workflows/tools using AI.  Excellent knowledge of working in cross-functional teams. Able to advocate for content design across various company areas and embed content design early in product planning.  Actively contributes to a content design system, creating reusable patterns and components   Experience in fintech or SaaS environments is a strong advantage. Strong communication skills - able to explain the “why” behind your decisions  Strong stakeholder management is a must for this role  Recruitment Process Application & portfolio review - we’re looking for exceptional content design case studies, showing examples of end-to-end product thinking, driven by research and illustrating impact.  Recruiter conversation - light intro on your background, team experience, and motivations. Leadership interview - deep dive into your skills and expertise with the lead content designer.  Content design task and portfolio presentation - a short task to assess how you approach content design and you’ll present a case study from your portfolio Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale. About this role As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.   Responsibilities 1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture Define European Hub Talent Strategy: Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers. Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative: Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent. Navigate Market Nuances: Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks. 2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence: Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets. End-to-End Pipeline Activation: Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners. Developer Platform Immersion: Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement. 3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement Targeted Campaign Architecture: Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines. Technical EVP Translation: Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors. Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits: Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion. 4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization Hiring-Centric Metrics: Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill. Budget Oversight: Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver. Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever): Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration. 5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment. Playbook Documentation: Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets. Mentorship & Functional Growth: Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales. Experience & Background 8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership: Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines. European Market Expertise: Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain). Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record: Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper. Fintech & Scale Exposure: Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments. International Collaboration: Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets. Skills & Competencies Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation: Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires. Deep Engineering Domain Fluency: Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences). Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity: High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments. Strategic Campaign Design: Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires). Paid Digital Campaign Optimization: Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks. What success looks like in this role First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion): Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring. First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins): Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles. First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp): Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires. Year One (Global Expansion Playbook): Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers. Why join us High-Impact Mission: Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally. True Ownership & Dedicated Resources: Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship. Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation: Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity. Competitive Executive Package: Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes. Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX)
description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role As a Senior Product Designer, you will shape financial experiences that millions of people rely on every day. Designing for money means designing for trust, often for people on low-end devices and unreliable internet connections, where a confusing screen can cost someone a sale. Your job is to take complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into experiences that are simple and trustworthy. You will join one of our product teams, working either on the products our customers use on POS, mobile and web, or on the operational tools our teams use to serve them. You will work alongside a product manager and engineers, with support from researchers and content designers. What you'll do Lead design for a customer-facing product or an operational tool, from discovery through launch and the improvements that follow. Frame the problem with your product and engineering partners before designing the solution. Think in systems, creating templates and patterns that can be configured and reused across products and platforms, and help evolve our design system. Design for accessibility and inclusion from the start, so our products work for everyone, whatever their ability, device or level of digital literacy. Turn complex customer and business problems into simple journeys people can trust, crafted down to the smallest detail. Stay with the work through build so that what ships matches what was designed, then measure its impact and keep improving it. Present your work with conviction and defend your decisions with clear reasoning, to designers, partners and leadership. Prototype early and test with real customers and real data, changing direction when the evidence says so. Raise the quality of design around you through critique and mentoring. What you need to succeed 7+ years of product design experience, leading complex, ambiguous projects end to end with minimal direction. A portfolio of shipped work that shows exceptional craft and clear thinking: the problem, your role, your decisions and what changed as a result. A record of framing the problem with product and engineering partners, not only designing the solution. Strong interaction and visual design skills across mobile and web, with a sharp eye for hierarchy, typography, layout and detail. Strong systems thinking: you design flexible templates and reusable patterns that adapt through configuration rather than one-off screens. A deep commitment to accessibility and inclusive design, with strong knowledge of the standards and shipped work that shows it. The ability to use both research and data to inform and evaluate design decisions. The confidence to advocate for your design decisions and hold your ground with senior stakeholders, in writing and in person, while staying open to better evidence. Experience giving useful critique and helping other designers grow. Hands-on experience using AI tools to explore and prototype faster, while owning the judgment and the quality of the result. Nice to have Experience designing for POS terminals is a strong plus. Experience in financial services, multiple markets or operational tools is also welcome. What you’ll get A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources. What to expect in the hiring process Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership. Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations. Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough. Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking. Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design. How to apply: Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description: About us Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest growing company in Africa.Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role As a Senior UX researcher, you’ll be the voice of our users. You’ll play a critical role in shaping our product strategy by uncovering deep insights into the needs, behaviours, and aspirations of our users—especially within Nigeria. We’re on a mission to create financial happiness for every African, and your research will directly influence how we design products that are accessible, intuitive, and impactful. You’ll collaborate closely with our creators to ensure our solutions are grounded in real-world market realities. Key responsibilities Lead and execute end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research across the product lifecycle—from discovery to delivery. Use a range of methods including in-depth interviews, ethnographic studies, usability testing, surveys, and diary studies, with a focus on the Nigerian context. Synthesise complex data into actionable insights and frameworks (personas, journey maps, mental models) that drive empathy across the team. Stay ahead of fintech and consumer trends in Nigeria and comparable markets through continuous landscape analysis. Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business challenges into research questions. Act as the subject matter expert on Nigerian user needs, guiding our local expansion and regional growth across Africa. Structure and scale our research operations, including participant management and maintaining organised research repositories. Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels to drive action and product improvements. Qualifications 6+ years of experience in UX research or product research, ideally with digital B2C products. Deep experience researchng African markets, specifically Nigeria. Advanced expertise in qualitative and quantitative methodologies (co-creation, usability testing, literature reviews, etc.). Hands-on experience with tools like UserTesting, Maze, Typeform, or similar platforms. Proven track record of translating insights into tangible frameworks that guide business decisions. Preferred qualifications Experience building or engaging with active user communities in Nigeria. Background in fintech or banking environments. Experience scaling research practices in a fast-growth startup or scale-up. About you  You're driven by mastery and want to make the world a better place through your work. You love finding innovative ways to solve user problems. You speak the language of our users. You don't try to sound impressive with technical jargon; you stay relatable and friendly. You don't guess—you use data. You prefer not to speak if you're unsure of the facts.  You believe in Moniepoint’s mission and want to bring our audience along on the journey to financial happiness. What success looks like Product teams report a clearer understanding of user pain points, measured by feature adoption and user satisfaction. Research insights are consistently used to inform the product roadmap and business strategy. We establish a thriving research repository that is easily accessible to all product stakeholders. User recruitment becomes a seamless, automated process that allows for faster research cycles. You become the "go-to" person for understanding the Nigerian consumer’s financial journey. Please submit a resume highlighting your research experience and outlining research methodologies, processes, and the impact of your work on user experience and business outcomes. Optionally, you may also include a PDF portfolio with case studies that further illustrate your research approach and results. While a portfolio is not required, it can provide additional insight into your end-to-end research thinking and influence on product direction. Our hiring process Resume review: We look for strong experience that showcases your research process, methodologies, and impact. Technical interview with a senior researcher: Deep dive into your experience, approach, and alignment with our mission. Case study presentation: Present a research project to a panel, demonstrating your problem-solving, research craft, and strategic thinking. Executive interview: Discussion with senior leadership about your growth potential, influence, and ability to drive user and business success.

Fluency in both research and data: you know which questions each can answer, and you use them to set direction and to judge whether shipped work succeeded. Career growth opportunities. A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration. Competitive compensation and benefits. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Who we are Moniepoint is one of Africa’s fastest-growing fintech companies, recognised by the Financial Times for three consecutive years. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the role We are hiring a Technical Recruiter with demonstrated ownership of the full hiring lifecycle and the ability to operate with clarity, structure, and consistency. title: Team Lead, System Administrator
description: Who we are Moniepoint is an all-in-one financial services platform for emerging markets and the second-fastest-growing company in Africa. Since 2019, Moniepoint’s technology has powered over 3 million people, offering personal and business banking, payment, credit and business management tools to help them succeed. Moniepoint processed $182 billion in 2023, and currently processes the majority of the POS transactions in Nigeria.  Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. About the Role The Team Lead, Systems Administration, is a senior individual contributor who also leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. This role is responsible for both the hands-on delivery of complex systems work and the orchestration of team priorities, standards, and output quality. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in networking, cloud infrastructure, security, and automation with the leadership capability to coach a team, enforce SOPs, and drive measurable operational excellence, including leveraging AI tools to optimise how the team works. This role sits at the Team Lead level in Moniepoint's Talent Architecture. Success is defined not only by personal technical output, but by the team's consistent performance and delivery against infrastructure-wide targets. Scope & Decision Horizon Leads the IT infrastructure team tactically. Success is the orchestration of people and priorities to ensure the team's immediate output aligns with the broader roadmap. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Team Leadership & Operations Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Systems Administrators, ensuring consistent output quality and adherence to SOPs. Manage team workload, prioritise tasks across competing demands, and ensure SLA compliance across all infrastructure functions. Conduct regular 1:1s, deliver direct and specific performance feedback, and actively develop team members' technical skills. Design and enforce team workflows and escalation paths, ensuring quality is consistent regardless of who executes the task. Own team-level metrics: system uptime (99.9%+), ticket SLAs, incident response times, and end-user satisfaction. Identify gaps in team capability or process and proactively close them through training, tooling, or workflow redesign. Infrastructure Management Design, implement, and maintain a robust IT infrastructure, including servers and virtualisation platforms (Proxmox). Administer and optimise Windows Server, Linux systems, and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Maintain comprehensive system documentation, network diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Plan and execute system upgrades with minimal downtime; optimise for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Cloud & Network Infrastructure Design, deploy, and manage cloud network environments across GCP, OCI, and Azure, Outpost, including VPCs, subnets, peering, firewall rules, and private connectivity. Administer and optimise BGP routing policies, virtual routers (vRTF), and F5 load balancers across the enterprise network and cloud environments. Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points). Implement and maintain network security protocols, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage DNS, DHCP, Directory as a Service, and other core network services. Monitor network performance, analyse bandwidth utilisation, and implement QoS policies. AI Tools & Workflow Automation Manage, maintain, and evaluate AI tools used across the IT and infrastructure function, ensuring reliability, access control, and appropriate use. Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n and similar platforms to optimise repetitive operational processes. Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for network deployment, incident triage, and infrastructure monitoring. Coach team members on responsible AI integration, when to use AI tools, how to validate outputs, and where human review is required. Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil through intelligent automation and continuously improve the team's automation capabilities. Telephony & Unified Communications Administer and maintain the xCALLY PBX platform, including call routing, IVR configuration, queue management, and agent provisioning. Troubleshoot telephony incidents end-to-end: SIP trunks, PBX dial plans, voice quality, and carrier integration. Coordinate with ISPs and telecom carriers to ensure uptime and quality of voice services across all sites. Automation & Scripting Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency. Utilise Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) for consistent and scalable infrastructure deployment. Build and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and Nagios. Document automation and tooling clearly enough for an Associate-level team member to execute independently. Security & Compliance Implement and enforce IT security policies, access controls, and data protection measures across on-premise and cloud environments. Manage endpoint security solutions, patch management, and privileged access management. Manage user authentication systems, including SSO, MFA, and identity governance. Lead incident response: manage security events, conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA), and implement permanent fixes. User Endpoint & Technical Support Oversee onboarding and offboarding procedures, ensuring seamless first-day experiences and complete account lifecycle management. Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, group management, Drive policies, and app integrations. Manage MDM solutions for corporate devices across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Provide or oversee expert-level L2/L3 support, ensuring timely resolution and minimal user disruption. Manage IT asset inventory, lifecycle, and procurement coordination. Qualifications, Competencies & Skills Education & Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of proven experience in systems administration, infrastructure, or network engineering roles. At least 2 years of formal or informal team leadership, including coaching, delegation, and performance feedback. Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft, GCP/Azure/OCI cloud, Linux) are highly desirable, but not compulsory. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Active Directory / Directory as a Service (e.g., JumpCloud); Linux/Unix administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian). Cloud networking expertise across GCP, OCI, and Azure: VPCs, subnets, load balancers, private service connect, VPN gateways, and cloud firewall management. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP routing protocols, switching, VLANs, and enterprise network architecture across data centre and WAN environments. Hands-on experience with virtual routers (vRTF), F5 load balancers, and enterprise networking equipment (Cisco, Ubiquiti). Virtualisation experience with Proxmox; data centre operations including rack and stack, power, cooling, and structured cabling. Experience administering xCALLY PBX or equivalent enterprise telephony/unified communications platforms. Proficiency in scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash; experience with Ansible and Terraform. Hands-on experience with n8n or equivalent workflow automation platforms for building and managing operational automations. Experience managing AI tools within an IT environment, including access control, integration, and responsible use governance. Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, PRTG) and endpoint/MDM management platforms. Proficiency in Google Workspace administration: user and group management, Drive, Gmail, Meet, and third-party app integrations. Advanced infosec tooling experience (e.g., CrowdStrike); knowledge of Disaster Recovery protocols and DR drills. Experience with Jira Service Management; understanding of SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Leadership & Soft Skills Proven ability to lead a technical team: delegate effectively, deliver feedback, and develop others. Exceptional analytical and systematic troubleshooting approach; moves fast without compromising rigour. Strong documentation discipline — produces SOPs and runbooks clear enough for junior team members to execute. Candid communicator: surfaces risks early, documents dissent, and challenges direction constructively. Customer-obsessed: identifies and permanently resolves recurring pain points, not just individual tickets. Working Conditions This role may require occasional weekend or after-hours work to perform system maintenance, upgrades, and respond to critical incidents. Physical requirements may include lifting equipment up to 50 lbs. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, and health insurance. What to expect in the hiring process A technical interview with a member of the Infrastructure team. A take-home assessment A behavioral and technical interview with a member of the executive team.

title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. Job Title: Workforce Business Partner (Lagos) Reports to: Team Lead, Workforce Partner Job Purpose The Workforce Business Partner (WBP) serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, driving the alignment of people strategy with business priorities. This role exists to ensure that every people-related initiative — from performance enablement and workforce planning to leadership effectiveness — is executed with precision, empathy, and measurable impact. Beyond traditional HR delivery, the WBP acts as a trusted advisor, shaping organizational health and fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and inclusion. The role bridges the gap between business needs and people solutions, ensuring that talent is positioned as a key enabler of growth and innovation. Key Responsibilities Partner with business leaders to translate organizational goals into actionable people plans that drive capability, performance, and retention. Lead workforce planning and organizational design discussions to ensure the right structure, roles, and talent are in place to meet current and future needs. Coach and influence leaders on talent strategy, performance management, and Independent Contractor engagement to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team culture. Act as a trusted advisor on IC relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and business-aligned resolutions in collaboration with the Workforce Relations COE. Analyze people data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, presenting data-driven recommendations to business leaders. Champion change management and communication strategies that support transformation, adoption, and continuous improvement within business units. Ensure compliance with internal policies and local labor laws while promoting a positive, high-performance culture.  Qualifications 2–4 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in a Business Partnership or advisory capacity. Demonstrated experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, or multinational environments. Strong understanding of core HR functions — performance management, people relations, organizational design, and workforce planning. Proven ability to use HR data and analytics to inform decision-making. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting technical or commercial business units in a fintech, banking, or tech environment. Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading complex change initiatives. About You You’re a strategic thinker who sees the big picture but executes with precision. You build trust quickly and communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence. You thrive in ambiguity and can balance multiple stakeholders with ease. You’re data-driven — you make decisions grounded in insight, not intuition. You’re committed to continuous improvement, always seeking better ways to drive business impact through people. What Success Looks Like  You have established yourself as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, influencing key people and organizational decisions. Business units under your support demonstrate improved engagement, retention, and performance outcomes. You’ve delivered a measurable improvement in workforce planning accuracy and performance management effectiveness. Leaders actively seek your input on strategic and people-related matters, not just HR processes. You’ve successfully embedded at least one COE-led initiative (e.g., new policy, performance framework, or workforce process) within your business unit with strong adoption and feedback. Why join us Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities. Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.

The role balances business pragmatism with empathy and legal compliance, enabling leaders to make informed, people-centered decisions that reinforce Moniepoint’s values. Key Responsibilities Partner with leaders, Workforce Business Partners, Legal team and relevant stakeholders to resolve complex independent contractors relations cases with fairness, consistency, and business alignment. Provide expert guidance on disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, and terminations, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and internal policies. Act as a strategic consultant to leadership teams, identifying systemic issues and recommending proactive interventions to minimize engagement risks. Analyze Workforce Relations trends, patterns, and case data to identify root causes, drive preventive strategies, and inform policy updates. Partner with the Employee Relations Partner to design, review, and implement employee relations frameworks, policies, and toolkits across entities. Build ER capability across the People Team and business leaders through coaching, education, and practical toolkits. Support change management initiatives and culture programs that foster open communication, inclusion, and psychological safety. Lead or support sensitive investigations involving complex or high-risk matters, ensuring due process and confidentiality throughout. Serve as a trusted voice of objectivity, balancing independent contractor advocacy and organizational needs in every decision. Qualifications 3–6 years of progressive HR or Employee Relations experience, including direct case management in a complex or regulated environment. Strong knowledge of labor laws and employment practices across multiple geographies (experience within Africa is an advantage). Proven experience managing investigations, conflict resolution, and policy enforcement. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders confidently. Must reside in the North. Fluent in Hausa.  Preferred Qualifications Professional certification (e.g., CIPM, SHRM, or relevant Legal/ER specialization). Experience in fintech, banking, or other high-growth, multi-entity organizations. Demonstrated success implementing ER frameworks or leading cross-functional risk mitigation initiatives. About You You’re calm, objective, and grounded — even in high-stakes situations. You balance empathy with fairness and have strong judgment on what’s “right” versus what’s “easy.” You communicate with clarity and confidence, building trust at every level. You think systemically — you see patterns behind cases and design solutions that prevent recurrence. You value compliance but see your role as enabling business success, not blocking it. What Success Looks Like  You are recognized as a trusted advisor by business and HR leaders on complex ER and compliance matters. Consistent, fair, and timely resolution of Independent Contractors relations issues across all entities. Reduced recurrence of ER incidents through proactive coaching, early intervention, and data-led prevention. Enhanced ER literacy among managers and WBPs through structured education and guidance. Policies and practices are perceived as clear, fair, and aligned with Moniepoint’s culture and legal standards. Why join us Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and impactful career growth opportunities. Fully remote/flexible work culture backed by continuous support for your learning and professional development.
